forum.title: In a TouchGFX project, how do I use GPU2D to draw independently?
forum.best_answer_content:
I kind of know what is wrong.

At the begaining of render，I enabled nema\_enable\_gradient(1); So the nema\_clear can not work.

If I put nema\_enable\_gradient(1) after nema\_clear, the nema\_clear become normal.
forum.content_text: **I am currently using TouchGFX to develop a project. How can I independently control GPU2D to draw graphics on a dynamic bitmap without affecting the TouchGFX display? I have already obtained the NeoChromSDK, but the examples in the NeoChromSDK all use GPU2D independently as well.  I can draw with GPU2D if touchgfx not in use,But once I display them both, screen got glitched.**
forum.author: AMB01

scraped_replies.html: Use TouchGFX dynamic bitmaps. Render into them via TouchGFX APIs.
scraped_replies.author: loveforcircuits

scraped_replies.html:
This is what I have done:

This terrain is rendered by lots of triangles. The terrain itself is fine,but the background is not.

I cleared the dynamic bitmap and draw like this :

 
nema_bind_dst_tex((uintptr_t)pbuf, 460, 460, NEMA_RGB565, -1);

nema_set_clip(0, 0, 460, 460);

nema_clear(nema_rgba(0, 0, 255, 0xff));

for(){

drawTriangles();

}

But the nema_clear seems not working.

Can I get some help from some @st_it guys?
scraped_replies.author: AMB01

scraped_replies.html:
I kind of know what is wrong.

At the begaining of render，I enabled nema_enable_gradient(1); So the nema_clear can not work.

If I put nema_enable_gradient(1) after nema_clear, the nema_clear become normal.
